title: Ski Tracks Run Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Slopes ski sessions (`slopes:session`), Ski Tracks runs (`skitracks:run`), OnTheSnow resort reports (`onthesnow:report`), snow safety checks (`snow:safety`), and Ikon Pass lift scans (`ikon:pass`).
app: Slopes ski sessions, Ski Tracks GPS runs, OnTheSnow resort reports, snow safety checklist logs, and Ikon Pass scan exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=skitracks:run
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by trail_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>72
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Ski Tracks run data has stopped arriving for a given trail.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per trail and alert when the feed is older than 72 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It measures when one part of your Ski Tracks run feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
